101-803-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
101-803-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Arcane Adaptation, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3558-5006-8095-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crookshank Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
3558-5006-8095-8170.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crookshank Kobolds spell. Then, activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

132-3263-4687-4851.easyPrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
132-3263-4687-4851.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Timeless Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G/U}.
Activate Myr Welder using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, targeting any permanent.
Repeat.

1479-1659-2841-8104.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Misty Rainforest.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-1659-2841-8104.description:
Fetch a land using Misty Rainforest.
When the fetched land enters, Seed the Land and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Seed the Land trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Seed the Land triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1479-2841-7889-8099.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Prismatic Vista.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-7889-8099.description:
Fetch a land using Prismatic Vista.
When the fetched land enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

586-4247-5258-5618-6121.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two lore counters on it

957-2239-7879.easyPrerequisites: You have at least eight cards in hand.
957-2239-7879.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its third chapter ability then triggers, causing you to cast Time Stretch and Ardent Elementalist without paying their mana costs, and then exiling The Great Synthesis and returning it to the battlefield as Jin-Gitaxias.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist spell. When it enters, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Jin-Gitaxias by paying {3}{U}, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as The Great Synthesis.
When The Great Synthesis enters with a lore counter on it, its first ability triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to the number of cards in your hand and not have a maximum hand size for the rest of the game.
Move to your first extra turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase, The Great Synthesis triggers, putting a lore counter on it. Its second chapter ability then triggers, returning all non-Phyrexian creatures (including Ardent Elementalist) from the battlefield to their owner's hand.
Repeat from step 1 during your second extra turn
957-2239-7879.notes: The combo is listed as near-infinite turns because you'll draw cards at a much faster rate than normal, which will result in you getting less turns.

2034-6968-6970-7763-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

1494-1742-7720-7811.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Iron Man triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

2122-3384-6822.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw two cards.
Lyla triggers twice, putting two +1/+1 counters on Mindless Automaton
Repeat.

1018-1987-2510.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
1018-1987-2510.notablePrerequisites: There is an instant card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1018-1987-2510.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1018-1987-2510.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

215-5709-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Forests.
215-5709-7175.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Rofellos from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Rofellos by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4302-4875-5686.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
4302-4875-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Conspiracy, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

1987-4423-4872-7487.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-4423-4872-7487.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Zealous Lorecaster.
When Zealous Lorecaster and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

2034-4907-6709-6989.easyPrerequisites: Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more charge counters on it

2593-4067-6281-7327.description:
Activate Astral Cornucopia by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Ragamuffin Raptor.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Ragamuffin Raptor that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Ragamuffin Raptor token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ragamuffin Raptor from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Astral Cornucopia.
Repeat.

2281-5237-6798.easyPrerequisites: You had a permanent leave the battlefield this turn.
2281-5237-6798.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Renegade Rallier
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Renegade Rallier
When Renegade Rallier dies, Saffi triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

944-4943-7070.description:
Activate Lancers en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Lancers en-Kor.
The Lancers en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Lancers en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Planar Gate.
Repeat.

1170-1329-3200-4927.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Urza's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1978-4851-5089.description:
Animate Timeless Lotus using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate Timeless Lotus by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Timeless Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

3525-5089-6788.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand with the mana to cast it, including at least one colored mana.
3525-5089-6788.description:
Animate Solar Array, if needed.
Cast Pemmin's Aura by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Solar Array.
Activate Solar Array by tapping it, adding {U} and causing the next artifact spell you cast this turn to have sunburst.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Solar Array.
Repeat from step 3 as desired.
Cast any artifact spell, triggering its sunburst ability an infinite number of times, either putting infinite +1/+1 counters on charge counters on the artifact.
3525-5089-6788.notes: This combo can be repeated whenever you want to cast an artifact spell. If needed as well, you can tap Solar Array for colored mana to use in casting that spell, assuming you do not want to continue the combo after the spell is cast.

1429-4659-6792.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Repeat.

292-1887-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1887-4968.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

710-1258-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Abduction triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Abduction from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token.
Repeat.

2099-2558-5687-5690.description:
Activate Sarcatog's second ability by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Ruination Guide, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

3174-4691-5919.description:
Cast Switcheroo by paying {4}{U}, exchanging control of Vilis and another creature with an opponent.
During that opponent's draw step, they draw a card.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Vilis triggers, causing the opponent to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 until the opponent loses the game either due to drawing from an empty library, or from having 0 life.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

816-4090.description:
When damage would be dealt to you, that damage is redirected to the creature that has Pariah attached instead.
Because Rune-Tail's Essence prevents damage being dealt to creatures you control, the creature with Pariah attached takes no damage.

803-1379-1558-4338.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five other creatures.
"Cleric" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1379-1558-4338.description:
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five other creatures.
When the creatures die as Clerics due to Arcane Adaptation, Rotlung Reanimator triggers five times, creating five 2/2 Zombie creature tokens.
Resolve the Time Sieve ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

228-1475-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness equal to one, except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
228-1475-4871.description:
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to a creature with toughness equal to one, except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
The creature dies as a state based action due to having zero or less toughness, triggering One with the Kami, Skullclamp, and Pitiless Plunderer.
Resolve the One with the Kami trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to the creature's power.
Resolve the Skullclamp trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

147-1987.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Ghostly Flicker.
147-1987.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Ghostly Flicker, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

1987-2510-3277-5116.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1987-2510-3277-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Izzet Chronarch, blinking them.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

250-293-779-1295-2890-4892-5014-5188.description:
Cast Flash putting Protean Hulk into play.
Protean hulk dies with trigger, grabbing putrid imp and gitrog monster.
Discard dakmor salvage to putrid imp, trigger gitrog to draw, replace draw for dredge 2 on dakmor salvage.
Repeat step 3 until either no cards are left in library or you are comfortable with what is left.
By this point a Narcomoeba has been milled (hopefully) and is now on your field.Sacrificegitrog, Narcomoeba, and putrid imp to flashback dread return in grave target thassa's oracle and win.
